# Omni Engine (v2.2.2)
> The Sovereign, In-Process Autonomous Software Engineering Runtime

## Overview
Omni Engine is an offline, zero-cloud autonomous software engineering runtime written in pure Rust with direct in-process C-FFI bindings to llama.cpp. It acts as a deterministic compiler swarm delivering tested, verified multi-file software directly to host disk with Bubblewrap cleanroom sandboxing and causal KV-cache slicing.

## Documentation Index
- [README.md](README.md): Architecture overview, core capabilities, quickstart, and CLI reference.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Full autonomous agent integration specification, tool calling schemas, invariant contracts, and Maestro protocol.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): System dependencies, upstream llama.cpp version (Build 11429), and dynamic linkage details.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): Systems engineering roadmap, acceleration backends, and milestones.

- [examples/maestro_plan.json](examples/maestro_plan.json): Canonical JSON schema and blueprint example for the Maestro Plan Protocol.
- [examples/atlr_maestro_plan.json](examples/atlr_maestro_plan.json): Comprehensive 50-thread ATLR concurrent financial ledger blueprint example.

## Core CLI Usage
- `omni_engine download <preset|url>`: Download GGUF models directly with live progress bar (presets: `--qwen`, `--qwen-7b`, `--phi-4`).
- `omni_engine run "<goal>" --output-dir <dir> --review`: Synthesize new multi-file project from scratch with human/agent review.
- `omni_engine run --plan-file <plan.json> --output-dir <dir> -y`: Execute pre-compiled Maestro architectural blueprint (the plan JSON file MUST be written to disk before running; pass -y for non-interactive auto-dependency installation).
- `omni_engine modify "<goal>" --dir <dir> --output-dir <dir> --review`: Incrementally extend existing codebase with Zero-Wipe Invariant.
- `omni_engine tui`: Launch full-screen graphical Terminal Dashboard (Ratatui).
- `omni_engine console`: Launch interactive REPL console shell.
- `omni_engine serve --port 8090`: Launch local Web UI and OpenAI-compatible HTTP proxy API.
